test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

To make a low continuous vibratory sound expressing contentment (of a cat).
solution: The correct answer is Option 2. i.e. **"To purr"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **To purr:** Make a low continuous vibratory sound expressing contentment. (गुर्राना: संतोष व्यक्त करने वाली एक निम्न सतत कंपनशील ध्वनि करना।) • **Example**: The cat began to purr contentedly as its owner petted it softly. Therefore, the correct answer is "To purr". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **To meow:** Make the crying sound characteristic of a cat. (म्याऊँ करना: एक बिल्ली की विशेषता वाली रोने की आवाज़ करना।) • **To buzz: **Make a continuous, low sound such as that made by a bee. (भिनभिनाना: एक मधुमक्खी द्वारा की गई ध्वनि के समान एक निरंतर, निम्न ध्वनि करना।) • **To roar:** Make a loud, deep sound. (दहाड़ना: एक जोरदार, गहरी ध्वनि करना।) 4c:Ta2c, The correct answer is **Option 2** i.e. **To accept punishment for some mistake which you have done**.
